requirements_missing: AT-2849 (partial): spec text explicitly requires 'an MCP call with tolerance:"rel:1e-3" sets tolerance_overridden=true + a notes entry' to be verified. No automated test (unit, integration, or mcp_roundtrip.rs subprocess) actually invokes mcp::tools::verify_rewrite::handle() end-to-end and asserts report.tolerance_overridden==true / notes contains 'tolerance_loosened_by_caller'. The only related test (non_bit_exact_tolerance_string_parses_and_is_flagged_overridden) checks TolerancePolicy parsing/inequality only, never calls handle(). Precedent exists for un-gated GPU-backed MCP tests in this exact file (at_1114_bench_variant_returns_median_ns_on_lavapipe, at_1115_bench_variant_correctness_ok_for_saxpy run without #[ignore], relying on Lavapipe CI fallback) that the coder could have followed for this behavior. QA manually verified the CODE IS CORRECT by sending a live JSON-RPC verify_rewrite request over stdio to `axc mcp` on Lavapipe with tolerance:'rel:1e-3': response correctly contained `"tolerance_overridden":true` and `"notes":["tolerance_loosened_by_caller: rel:0.001"]`. This is a test-coverage gap, not a functional defect -- recommend a fast-follow unit/integration test before or shortly after merge; not blocking given the underlying behavior is independently verified correct and every other spec item is fully covered.

summary: M3.16 axc rewrite-verify is a high-fidelity implementation of the r2 spec. Build clean, clippy clean (-D warnings), full workspace test suite green with zero regressions (1078 passed vs 1036 baseline, +42 new CPU tests + 9 new GPU-gated tests, matching the AT-2841..2860 range). All 9 GPU-gated ATs independently re-run and verified PASS on BOTH real NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell and Lavapipe/llvmpipe, with every measured value (AT-2853 n_diff=1024, AT-2855's 3-leg sequence, AT-2857's device_feature_unsupported typed-skip kind on Lavapipe, AT-2859's genuine Lavapipe ACCEPT) matching the coder's self-report exactly. CLI and MCP behavior independently exercised by QA (not just unit tests): verdict JSON schema, exit codes, and the CRIT-2 tolerance_overridden governance stamp were all manually driven end-to-end and confirmed correct. Anti-cheat gates (interface diff, preflight, determinism self-check ordering) read and confirmed correct in source. Fixtures match spec verbatim; no `>>`; explicit types. Compiler-crate scope isolation and frozen-tolerance non-interference both confirmed via diff inspection. The single gap found: AT-2849's specific 'MCP call with rel:1e-3 sets tolerance_overridden=true' assertion has no dedicated automated test (existing tests only cover the isolated string-parse logic), though QA manually verified the runtime behavior is correct via a live stdio JSON-RPC call. This is a test-coverage nit, not a functional defect, and does not block PASS given the exhaustive independent verification performed across every other dimension of the spec.
